## Appointment Reminders (24h ahead)
Runs every hour, reads each business from Google Sheets and looks 24-25 hours ahead in its Google Calendar, so every appointment is reminded exactly once (a small ledger blocks duplicates). The list goes to the practice; the delivery channel is a single swap at the end.
**Plug in:** Google Sheets credentials, YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID, Telegram (or swap the last node for SMS/WhatsApp).
**Test:** add a row for tomorrow and run manually.
